automation_evidence.quote:
Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling
environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions
and lead times before producing a report.

metric_evidence.quote: Zephyrus-R1 improves report quality under all three judges.

evidence.quote: Our key finding is that this report claim annotation is a difficult task even for domain experts, with significant inter-expert

practical_problems.note: grounding gate and claim-entailment reward target factual, evidence-backed reports; the expert audit checks the LLM judges' claim labels (reward reliability), not whether agent reports are faithful, and no ablation of the gate is run

summary: Two-stage RL (verifiable weather questions, then reports with a grounding-gated rubric and claim-entailment reward) improves report scores of 4B and 27B vision-language agents under three LLM judges; the expert audit validates the judges, so no practical problem is tested.
